body: Note that this will also bring along shearing, if any. However, I think that's a good thing. Even though it's not explicitly stated by the bools, if users want the rotation and scale copied, they probably also want the basis.
This does not correctly handle negative scale:

Just to confirm, what is the setup needed to reproduce what you have there? Because your screenshot says it's syncing both rotation *and* scale, which, in the code should end up just copying the basis instead of falling through to those if statements you are highlighting?

EDIT:
Never mind, I did find the issue (it flickers back and forth). It happens when rotation XOR scale are checked, so maybe you activated both before taking the screenshot. I'll have to come up with a more robust way to combine rotation and scale from different sources. Shouldn't be too difficult.

See my new comment in the main thread. There's a bigger discussion that needs to be had, I think.
